# `message_wait`

**Message Wait.** Wait up to 60 seconds for collaboration messages on a durable wait.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `message_wait` |
| Side effect | `create` |
| Idempotency | keyed on `idempotency_key` |
| Retry safe | yes |
